children: On August 25, 2026, the Nasdaq Listing and Hearing Review Council affirmed the March 25, 2026 decision to delist the company's ordinary shares from Nasdaq due to prior non-compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1). Trading has been suspended since March 27, 2026; Nasdaq's board may review the decision, and the shares are expected to be quoted on the OTC Expert Market.
